fr_html: Le raisonnement me paraît fondé. Examinons si le projet de Lord Phillimore, qui esquisse les moyens d'arriver à un tel accord, atteint le but qu'il se propose.
en_html: The argument appears to me well founded. Let us see if the project of Lord Phillimore, which outlines the means of reaching such an agreement, will attain its proposed end.
